name: Overnight + intraday trend
tagline: A 20/50-session trend holds the overnight, while a 0.6% intraday stop cuts the session's left tail.
summary: Starts each session long TQQQ when the 20/50 trend or a 50-day reclaim is intact, exits intraday on a 0.6% QQQ decline, re-enters on a reclaim, and skips the night if stopped and not reclaimed. Dev CAGR is 64.63% with 35.66% max drawdown and 1.42 Sharpe, but it fails at 10 bp (33.84%) and has no holdout.
caveat: Dev-only and not counted: the edge is a high-turnover intraday stop (1,837 fills, ~57 round trips a year) that falls to 33.84% at 10 bp, the worst held overnight gap was -20.5%, and 2020 alone contributes +308.5% (ex-2020 CAGR 44.06%), so a one-shot holdout is required before any above-TQQQ claim.
